title: Delete the entire destination number memory
body_md:
To delete the entire destination number memory, proceed as follows:

1. Disconnect the main wiring harness.
2. Set the operating mode switch to position E.
3. Re-insert the main wiring harness and wait until the status LED flashes yellow-green.
4. Set the operating mode switch back to the starting position.

The memory is then empty and can be reprogrammed with a new programming message.
